description: The app's own windows (main and the Quick window) may use Tauri's core APIs -- above all event listen, without which no shell event (GitHub sign-in finished, Ollama replies, download progress, deep links) ever reached the frontend. The remote GitHub sign-in window is deliberately not listed. autostart:default lets Settings → Startup enable, disable and read the login-autostart entry (on Linux an ~/.config/autostart .desktop file).
